claim: CloudFront supports content that can be sent using the HTTP or WebSocket protocols, including dynamic web pages and applications and popular static files, and it also supports delivery of live or on-demand media streaming over HTTP.

evidence.quote: Amazon CloudFront supports content that can be sent using the HTTP or WebSocket protocols.
Amazon CloudFront also supports delivery of live or on-demand media streaming over HTTP.

This includes dynamic web pages and applications, such as HTML or PHP pages or WebSocket-based applications, and any popular static files that are a part of your web application, such as website images, audio, video, media files or software downloads.
